definitions.explanation: A political system in which power is vested in the people, who rule either directly or through elected representatives.

examples.japanese: {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}を{守|まも}る。
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}{国家|こっか}。
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{基本|きほん}{原則|げんそく}。

notes:
{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ} is the standard term for democracy as a political ideology and system of government. The word is composed of {民主|みんしゅ} (people's sovereignty) + {主義|しゅぎ} (-ism).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}を{守|まも}る: to protect democracy
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}{国家|こっか}: a democratic nation
- {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}の{原則|げんそく}: principles of democracy

RELATED TERMS:
- {民主的|みんしゅてき}: democratic (na-adjective, used to describe processes or attitudes)
- {民主化|みんしゅか}: democratization
- {直接|ちょくせつ}{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: direct democracy
- {間接|かんせつ}{民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ}: representative democracy

CONTRAST:
Opposed to {独裁|どくさい} (dictatorship) and {専制|せんせい}{政治|せいじ} (autocracy). {民主主義|みんしゅしゅぎ} emphasizes the ideology, while {民主|みんしゅ}{政治|せいじ} refers specifically to democratic governance as a system.
